title: Zuga
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 3:2, Rabbi Yirmeyah said: Zuga went outside; Rabbi Chama, father of Rabbi Hoshaya, and Bar Kappara asked him. He came and asked Rabbi. Hyman proposes reading Zuna, as in Maaser Sheni, beginning of chapter 5: Zuna asked Rabbi. We also find in Bava Batra 164b: Zunin said to Rabbi.

notes.text: Hyman proposes Zuna for Zuga and compares the Zunin form. לבר means “outside,” not a place-name Bar Shalin.
